ignore_delete_triggers.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE t IGNORE DELETE TRIGGERS IMMEDIATE;

restrict_when_delete_triggers.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE t RESTRICT WHEN DELETE TRIGGERS IMMEDIATE;

reuse_storage.sql: TRUNCATE TABLE t REUSE STORAGE IMMEDIATE;

basic.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE d = 2;

correlation_columns.sql: UPDATE t AS x (a, b) SET a = 1 WHERE b = 2;

correlation_name.sql: UPDATE t AS x SET x.c = 1 WHERE x.d = 2;

fetch_first_only.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

for_portion_of_business_time.sql: UPDATE t FOR PORTION OF BUSINESS_TIME FROM '2020-01-01' TO '2021-01-01' SET c = 1 WHERE d = 2;

from_clause.sql: UPDATE t SET t.c = s.c FROM s WHERE t.k = s.k;

from_join.sql: UPDATE t SET t.c = s.c FROM u JOIN s ON u.k = s.k WHERE t.k = u.k;

from_subquery.sql: UPDATE t SET t.c = s.m FROM (SELECT k, MAX(x) m FROM u GROUP BY k) s WHERE t.k = s.k;

fullselect_target.sql: UPDATE (SELECT a, b FROM t) AS x (a, b) SET a = 1 WHERE b = 2;

include_columns.sql: UPDATE (SELECT a FROM t) INCLUDE (n INTEGER) SET n = 1, a = n;

isolation_cs.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE d = 2 WITH CS;

isolation_rr.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WITH RR;

isolation_rs_skip_locked.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WITH RS SKIP LOCKED DATA;

isolation_ur.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WITH UR;

offset_fetch.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 ORDER BY d OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

offset_only.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 OFFSET 5 ROWS;

order_by_fetch_first.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 ORDER BY d FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

positioned.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur;

positioned_correlation.sql: UPDATE t AS x SET x.c = 1 WHERE CURRENT OF cur;

set_attribute.sql: UPDATE t SET c..radius = 5, c..center..x = 1 WHERE id = 9;

set_multi_attribute.sql: UPDATE t SET (o, c..radius, c..center..x) = ('B', 5, 1) WHERE id = 9;

set_multi_column.sql: UPDATE t SET (a, b) = (1, NULL) WHERE d = 2;

set_null_default.sql: UPDATE t SET c = NULL, d = DEFAULT;

set_row_fullselect.sql: UPDATE t SET (a, b) = (SELECT x, y FROM s WHERE s.k = t.k) WHERE d = 2;

set_scalar_subquery.sql: UPDATE t SET a = (SELECT MAX(x) FROM s) WHERE d = 2;

view_target.sql: UPDATE v SET c = 1 WHERE d = 2;

wait_for_outcome.sql: UPDATE t SET c = 1 WAIT FOR OUTCOME;

with_cte.sql: UPDATE (WITH w AS (SELECT a, b FROM t) SELECT a, b FROM w) SET a = 1;

statements.whenever.name: WHENEVER
statements.whenever.reason: Embedded-SQL host construct handled by the precompiler (WHENEVER ... GOTO host-label / DO function-name()); never reaches the server's SQL parser.
